# AutoApply CV

> AutoApply CV is an AI job search assistant for software engineers and tech professionals. One Chrome extension auto-applies on LinkedIn (Easy Apply jobs), Naukri (jobs with Naukri's own Apply, answering the recruiter chatbot) and Indeed ("Easily apply" jobs only), using saved screening answers or AI, skipping jobs already applied to, and pausing when a question needs a human answer. It also sends WhatsApp and email outreach to recruiters from LinkedIn hiring posts. The dashboard tailors resumes for applicant tracking systems (ATS) and tracks every application. The Free plan includes 3 auto-apply actions per day plus a 30 Hires signup bonus; Pro costs ₹99 per month for unlimited auto-apply; Pro Connect costs ₹500 per month and adds HR Contacts (20 recruiter contacts a day, emailed every morning) and Interview Call AI (live answers from your own notes during interview calls).

## Product

- [Home](https://www.autoapplycv.in/): Overview of free auto apply for LinkedIn, Naukri and Indeed, plus recruiter outreach and AI job search tools.
- [Product overview](https://www.autoapplycv.in/product): The complete platform: LinkedIn, Naukri and Indeed auto apply, recruiter outreach, HR Contacts, Interview Call AI, AI resume optimization and application tracking.
- [Features](https://www.autoapplycv.in/features): Auto apply, recruiter outreach, HR Contacts, Interview Call AI, AI resume builder, job matching, tracker and analytics.
- [How it works](https://www.autoapplycv.in/how-it-works): Setup steps, page-ready submission checks, answer sync and pipeline tracking.
- [Pricing](https://www.autoapplycv.in/pricing): Free, Pro (₹99/month), Pro Connect (₹500/month) and pay-as-you-go Hires credits, and what is and is not charged.
- [HR WhatsApp contacts](https://www.autoapplycv.in/hr-whatsapp-contacts): Pro Connect's 20 daily recruiter contacts (WhatsApp-checked numbers and emails from public LinkedIn hiring posts).
- [Interview Call AI](https://www.autoapplycv.in/interview-call-ai): Live short answers from your own notes during interview or client calls on any call app.
